independence_scope: Distinct aggregate formulas from stored errors; no new GT reading or geometry recomputation. Same author as posthoc; not a separate research group replication.
limitations: Two synthetic development streams, not real-object identity tracking evidence or a held-out benchmark.

Ambiguous stay/exchange worlds explain identical observed RGBD; the very same predicted poses were loaded once and evaluated twice. Do not pool these world counts or use independent-frame confidence intervals.

Exchange world has 77 distractor outputs including every one of 70 post-opening tracking frames. Zero adjacent identity switches is caused by the 47 neither-associated frames breaking the chain; it does not mean no identity error.

All seven actual trust flags remain false; explicit abstention is not reported. Unverified is not successful abstention, working pose coverage is not verified identity coverage, and empty verified risk is null.
Neither means a finite working pose misses both fixed ADD thresholds; it is not an unknown or a successful abstention. Unknown slots are retained.

Timings include instrumentation and use different overlapping scopes. Registration/admission are contained in initialization; parent/child/initialization/tracking values must not be added. Measured tracking FPS excludes final output serialization; parent-inclusive throughput includes startup and orchestration. Neither is deployment FPS.
No raw poses, GT matrices, point trajectories, images, model assets, or machine-local paths are included.
